rules.name: Hypovolemic / Septic Shock
rules.message: CRITICAL: Patient shows signs of shock (hypotension + tachycardia). Immediate resuscitation required.
rules.action: Start IV fluids, call ICU, consider vasopressors, check lactate.

rules.name: Sepsis (qSOFA positive)
rules.message: CRITICAL: Sepsis suspected (qSOFA >=2). Start antibiotics, fluid resuscitation, lactate measurement.
rules.action: Blood cultures, broad-spectrum antibiotics, IV fluids, monitor lactate q2h, consider ICU.

rules.name: Acute Surgical Abdomen (Peritonitis)
rules.message: HIGH: Signs of peritonitis (guarding/rigidity). Surgical emergency. Urgent surgical consultation.
rules.action: NBM, IV fluids, analgesia, stat surgical review, prepare for theatre.

rules.name: Pediatric Respiratory Distress (Danger Signs)
rules.message: HIGH: Pediatric respiratory distress. Risk of hypoxia and fatigue.
rules.action: Oxygen, position upright, consider bronchodilators, prepare for intubation if worsening.

rules.name: Altered Mental State + Fever (Meningitis until proven otherwise)
rules.message: HIGH: Fever with altered mental state - possible meningitis. Urgent evaluation.
rules.action: IV antibiotics (ceftriaxone + vancomycin), CT head then lumbar puncture, dexamethasone.

rules.name: Pregnancy + Vaginal Bleeding + Pain (Ectopic Pregnancy)
rules.message: CRITICAL: Pregnant patient with bleeding + pain. Ectopic pregnancy until proven otherwise.
rules.action: IV access, crossmatch, urgent pelvic ultrasound, call gynecology, resuscitate if unstable.

rules.name: Chest Pain + Diaphoresis + Nausea (Acute Coronary Syndrome)
rules.message: HIGH: Chest pain with diaphoresis - possible ACS. Immediate ECG and troponin.
rules.action: Aspirin 300mg, Nitrates (if no hypotension), ECG, cardiac monitoring, cardiology referral.

rules.name: Pediatric Lethargy + Poor Feeding (Sepsis / Serious illness)
rules.message: HIGH: Child with lethargy and poor feeding - possible serious infection/sepsis.
rules.action: Full septic screen, IV antibiotics, IV fluids, monitor glucose, low threshold for PICU.
